test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2022: Official Paper (Held On: 09 March, 2023 Shift 4)
subject: general
question: Who has won the Miss India Worldwide 2022 pageant?
solution:
The correct answer is __Khushi Patel.__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Khushi Patel, a biomedical student from the United Kingdom, has been declared the winner of Miss India Worldwide 2022.
 
• Vaidehi Dongre from the US was declared the first runner up while Shrutika Mane was adjudged the second runner-up.
 
• It is the longest-running Indian pageant outside of India and is organised by India Festival Committee (IFC).
 
• It was the 29th edition of the pageant.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

 
• ​Femina Miss India 2022 is going to organise the 58th edition of the Femina Miss India beauty pageant.
 
• Manasa Varanasi of Telangana will crown her successor at the end of the event.
 
• The winner will represent India at Miss World 2022.
 
• Out of all the applications submitted from the 28 states, Delhi, Jammu and Kashmir, and other union territories.
 
• A group of top 3-19 candidates are chosen as state finalists and are publicised on the Femina Miss India Organization's official social media accounts.
